notes.title: Tiny Patch
notes.content:
Happy January everyone!

We heard that the quickly flashing day-night cycle that played at startup if you'd been gone a very long time was physically uncomfortable (or even a seizure risk) for some people, so we made a minor graphical adjustment.

Now, if it's been any more than 4 days, while your plants will still grow to reflect it, the time playback animation will only show 4 cycles. 

Love from Seattle!

notes.title: Major Summer Solstice Update!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

Sorry for the long silence! We’ve been distracted preparing Viridi for mobile. Now that it’s finally out (android / iOS), we’re able to bring all of the updates back to our beautiful and faithful Steam community.

Some of the more major changes:
New background: the Apartment!
Major visual unification overhaul - new custom shaders, cleaned up textures, lots of visual inconsistencies fixed
Cat House background updated/improved
New diverse snail colorations in different environments
Tab key now cycles through plants
Connection difficulties now reported to user in Nursery
Bug fix: dead/dying plants no longer animate their death on each load
Succulents now grow at a slightly more realistic pace
Succulents are now significantly more resilient
Overwatered succulents return to a Sated state much more quickly
Various flowering issues fixed
Default plant sizes tweaked
Links to various social media and support email added to Nursery
Plant selection/camera tweaked/improved
Improved feedback for Vacation Mode - a Welcome Back screen on return
Lots of bug fixes small and large


http://i.imgur.com/HTTrQW5.gif

notes.title: First major update
notes.content:
We have reached our first major update.

     New Environment
     A new succulent, Lithops optica 'Rubra'
     Vacation mode
     The grove environment now uses music from the grove in Eidolon
     Flowering achievements
     Achievements for "throwing your plants in the garden", formerly deleting plants


We also added patches and little changes.

     You can now use z to name stuff and it won't disappear your UI
     The nursery allows you to zoom in and manually rotate plants 
     Plucking weeds doesn't also select a different plant
     The snail farts when you pick it up
     Music does not constantly loop anymore

notes.title: Sept 13 Update
notes.content:
Camera locks more quickly & precisely while placing plants.
Zoom partially enabled while moving plants and snail, for increased precision.
Fixed a bug where backup saves weren't being properly reverted-to in some instances.
Spritz button is now disabled briefly after being pressed, to avoid accidental overwatering-deaths due to doubleclicks/lag.
Spritz/Thirst values tweaked so that spritzing once while Sated will never kill a plant.
New plants now start at the same size as starter plants, instead of automatically starting at the full size their space will allow (to help preserve pot space for easier rearranging).
Confirmation window on plant deletion clarified to exaggerate severity even further.
Flowers now last about a week (and some new flowers added).
Snail freed from trailing-plant prison—now moves freely, incorporally through all biological matter.


Keep your pants on - vacation mode (and other common requests) are on their way!
